We passed 10,000 users this morning.

Two years ago we were three people in a co-working space in Leeds, trying to work out whether small shops wanted inventory software at all.

The number I keep coming back to is 4,000. That's how many of those users came from referrals. We have never paid for an ad.

Plenty went wrong. We rebuilt the barcode scanner three times. In month eight we nearly ran out of money. If you're building something and it feels slow from the inside, that's what it felt like from inside this one too.

Thank you to the team, and to everyone who told a friend about us. That has been the whole growth strategy.
